name: Attention-Based Volumetric Rendering
aliases: Attention-Based Rendering With Learnable Embeddings for Neural Radiance Field
definition: A NeRF variant using Attention-based volumetric rendering and Learnable Embeddings (LE) to capture indirect lighting and improve rendering of glossy/transparent surfaces.
summary: Attention-Based Volumetric Rendering replaces physics-based equations with self-attention to handle view-dependent effects, distinguishing itself by applying transformers directly to volumetric modeling rather than feature aggregation.
